WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT "device.hostname", "dst_endpoint.domain", "http_request.url.hostname", message, "metadata.log_source", "metadata.uid", "query.hostname", time FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time >= '2026-09-24 07:00:00.000000' AND time < '2026-09-25 07:01:00.000000'
  AND (((((lower("dst_endpoint.domain") = 'bad.example' OR lower("query.hostname") = 'bad.example' OR lower("http_request.url.hostname") = 'bad.example'))) AND lower("metadata.log_source") != 'audit'))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT "device.hostname" AS "device.hostname", count() AS c
  FROM stage_0
  GROUP BY "device.hostname"
),
stage_2 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_1
  ORDER BY c DESC, "device.hostname" ASC
),
stage_3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_2
  LIMIT 50
),
__nano_stats_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, count() OVER () AS __nano_stats_total, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c DESC, "device.hostname" ASC ) AS __nano_stats_ordinal FROM stage_3
)
SELECT * FROM __nano_stats_ranked WHERE __nano_stats_ordinal = 1 OR (__nano_stats_ordinal > 0 AND __nano_stats_ordinal <= 501) ORDER BY __nano_stats_ordinal LIMIT 501 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=0, optimize_aggregation_in_order=0
